name: obs-tgi-tracing-py
notes: 63 lines total. setup_tracing(otlp_service_name, otlp_endpoint) installs a BatchSpanProcessor with an OTLP gRPC exporter, and a custom UDSOpenTelemetryAioServerInterceptor overrides _start_span to handle gRPC-over-Unix-socket calls. Span names are the raw gRPC method names with rpc.* attributes - generic RPC spans, not gen_ai spans.
